mr_description:
Update `StandardConfigDataLocationResolver` so that directory resources
are only required when the location is not optional.

expected_issues.title: Optional/mandatory check inverted for empty directory locations
expected_issues.description:
The condition is inverted: an optional directory location without sub-directories now fails, while a mandatory one without sub-directories is silently accepted.

The intent (and the commit title) is to only require sub-directories when the location is not optional. `location.isOptional() && isEmpty(...)` throws ConfigDataLocationNotFoundException for `optional:` pattern locations — the exact case meant to be allowed — and removes the check for mandatory ones. It must be `!location.isOptional()`.
